title: Enhancement: [Nexthop] NH-4220 - Log ASIC power good, set DP_PWR_ON
author: antonio-nexthop
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the enhancement

In `asic_init.sh` of NH-4220 device
- Set `DP_PWR_ON` deliberately to avoid edge case where power glitch causes it to be unset
- Log power good bit for extra telemetry

### Current Behavior

- `DP_PWR_ON` bit not explicitly set
- ASIC Power Good bit not logged

### Proposed Behavior

- `DP_PWR_ON` bit explicitly set
- ASIC Power Good bit logged

comments.author: yxieca
comments.body:
Summary:
- Adds a fpga_read() helper, defensively sets DP_PWR_ON before ASIC power-up to mitigate glitches, and logs ASIC_PGOOD status for NH-4220. Changes are scoped to the platform init script and look consistent with existing FPGA access patterns; logs provided.

Reviewed by: AI agent on behalf of Ying.

Non-blocking nits:
- Comment typo: DP_POWR_ON → DP_PWR_ON.
- Clarify/handle fpga_read return format when using $(( )) or convert explicitly.
- Optional: check fpga_write return/handle failure; currently continues silently.
- Minor style: quoting in logger calls; double space in fpga_write 0x90  0x1 "9:9".
- Consider constants for magic register addresses/bits; optional retry/abort if ASIC_PGOOD not set.
